description: Defines a serializable Java class ReadableProductList that encapsulates a list of ReadableProduct objects and a total count, representing a collection of products in a shopping or catalog system.

classes.name: ReadableProductList
classes.description: A Java class that maintains a list of products and the total number of products, designed for use in a web-based product catalog.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct objects for this product list.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total count of products.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of products.
